trial.evidence: “30-day trial for $0” on the Individual and Student cards and “Start free 30-day trial” on the sticky button of the web pricing page

ourRead: Strava + Runna comes first at $12.50 a month, so Individual at $6.67 looks like half price. Only Individual gets a light card, an orange button and “Save 44%”.
Each card leads with a per-month price; 3 of the 4 bill yearly only. Family turns $139.99 a year into $2.92 a month per person.
The trial runs 30 days, with a reminder 2 days before it ends. Individual and Student say “Try it free”; Family and the bundle say “Choose plan”.

improvements.title: Keep one orange button on screen
improvements.detail: On the Individual card, “Try it free” sits above the sticky “Start free 30-day trial”: 2 orange buttons on one screen. Make the card button an outline, like the other 3 cards.
improvements.rule: Emphasize the CTA. One filled primary button, everything else secondary or text.

improvements.title: Name what the trial unlocks
improvements.detail: The headline reads “The best of Strava. Built for your goals.” The timeline under it names the features: put them up top, as “Routes, segment leaderboards and training analysis, free for 30 days”.
improvements.rule: Make headlines specific. "Track 3 habits in 10 seconds a day" beats "Transform your life".

improvements.title: Write plan names in sentence case
improvements.detail: All 4 plan names are spaced capitals ending in “SUBSCRIPTION”, and 3 of them take 2 lines. Set them as Individual, Family, Student and Strava + Runna, and each fits on 1 line.
improvements.rule: Use ALL CAPS only for tiny labels, with +5% to +10% letter spacing.

stylePrompt: Build a dark paywall in Strava's style. Top to bottom: a red-to-black gradient hero with the logo and a bold 2-line headline, then a white trial timeline. Below: 4 stacked plan cards and a sticky full-width button. Type: Archivo, bold headlines, regular prices at 4x the body size. Colors: near black #141414 (60) for the page and cards, white #FFFFFF (30) for text, Strava orange #FD5200 (10) for the sticky button only. Put the priciest plan first as an anchor. Make the main plan the one light card: Annual preselected, price per month, yearly bill below, 30 days free. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
